abstract.text: Every vertex: the elements in ascending order, each from the bottom of its tower up.
Skip lists as sorted sets, with their levels as a directed graph.
A sorted set kept in a skip list: sorted linked lists stacked in levels, each level a random
sample of the one below, searched from the top level down (Pugh, 1990).
A skip list’s levels as a directed acyclic graph; see
The list’s levels as a directed graph: a vertex for each element on each level of its
tower, an edge from each to the next element on the same level, and an edge from each down
to the same element on the level below. The head is not a vertex.
